item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Reyansh's brass strip. A flame heats the left end. Drawing pins W, X, Y and Z are stuck with wax along the strip, with W nearest the flame and Z farthest.

Which claim about heat transfer along the strip is correct?

options.A: Heat moves by conduction from the hot end toward colder parts, so the pins fall in the order W, then X, then Y, then Z.
options.B: Heat moves by conduction from the cold end toward the flame, so the pins fall in the order Z, then Y, then X, then W.
options.C: All four pins fall at the same instant because brass is one solid piece.
options.D: Only pin W can fall, because heat never leaves the flame end of a solid strip.
